rows.definition: FixedContextTokens (internal/macfit ModelTier) is the context length a tier's engine always admits. When it is non-zero the turnkey plan uses it as the context budget instead of sizing the context from the KV pool; zero keeps the pool-derived budget. Inkling2MiniTier sets it to the Inkling-2 launcher's single-session context.
rows.distinction: A per-tier planning constant of the Apple Silicon turnkey sizer, not a measured or negotiated window. It is NOT the context window concept itself, NOT the full-context token count of a request, and NOT a serve-time context budget flag: it only replaces the KV-pool-derived ContextBudgetTokens in a macfit TurnkeyProfile.

rows.definition: RefuseInkling2LoopBackend (internal/model/arch_support.go) is the single backend-admission predicate for the inkling2_loop looped forward: it returns nil when the named compute backend runs the looped forward and a typed UnsupportedInkling2LoopExecutionError otherwise. fak serve calls it before loading, and fak up calls it to decide whether Inkling-2-Mini may be the Apple Silicon default.
rows.distinction: A capability check on a compute backend name, not a loop and not a loop configuration. It is NOT Inkling2LoopConfig (the checkpoint's layer-pass schedule) and has nothing to do with agent, goal or orchestration loops; the word loop here names the model architecture it gates.
